errors.text_span: fällt im Januar 2020 auf etwa -10 Mrd. US-$
errors.evidence: The purple line has a value of approximately 50 Mrd. US-$ in January 2020. The sharp dip to a minimum of approximately -20 Mrd. US-$ occurs after January 2020, not at that specific time, and the minimum value is -20, not -10.

errors.text_span: beginnt im Juli 2014 bei etwa 900 Mrd. US-$
errors.evidence: The blue line starts in July 2014 at a value of approximately 950 Mrd. US-$, which is significantly higher than the stated 900 Mrd. US-$.

errors.text_span: fällt bis Januar 2016 auf etwa 800 Mrd. US-$
errors.evidence: The value of the blue line in January 2016 is approximately 950 Mrd. US-$. The line never falls to 800 Mrd. US-$; its lowest value is around 900 Mrd. US-$ in mid-2017.

errors.text_span: steigt bis Ende 2017 wieder auf etwa 90 Mrd. US-$
errors.evidence: At the end of 2017 (the tick for 01/2018), the value of the purple line is approximately 75-80 Mrd. US-$, not 90 Mrd. US-$.
